scripts.build: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run build -w @erp/web && npm run build -w @erp/api
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @erp/shared && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.test.json && node --test .local/test-build/api/test/*.test.js .local/test-build/shared/test/*.test.js && npm run test:ui
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run db:seed -w @erp/api && npm run db:seed:procurement && npm run db:seed:sales && npm run db:seed:hr && npm run db:seed:accounting && npm run db:seed:manufacturing && npm run db:seed:automatic-accounting && npm run db:seed:attendance && npm run db:seed:rfq
scripts.db:seed:procurement: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run build -w @erp/api && node scripts/seed-procurement.mjs
scripts.db:seed:rfq: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run build -w @erp/api && node scripts/seed-rfq.mjs
scripts.db:seed:attendance: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run build -w @erp/api && node scripts/seed-attendance.mjs
scripts.db:seed:hr: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run build -w @erp/api && node scripts/seed-hr.mjs
scripts.db:seed:sales: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run build -w @erp/api && node scripts/seed-sales.mjs
scripts.db:seed:accounting: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run build -w @erp/api && node scripts/seed-accounting.mjs
scripts.db:seed:manufacturing: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run build -w @erp/api && node scripts/seed-manufacturing.mjs
scripts.db:seed:automatic-accounting: npm run build -w @erp/shared && npm run build -w @erp/api && node scripts/seed-automatic-accounting.mjs
